title: The Bell Below Blackfen
theme: Flooded shrine beneath a ruined tollhouse
hook: A cracked bell rings under the marsh every midnight. Each peal draws lights from nearby graves toward the old tollhouse causeway.
background: The tollhouse was built over a sealed shrine to a forgotten river saint. Bandits broke the seal while hiding contraband, and now rival scavengers, spirits, and waterlogged hazards crowd the rooms below.

layout.notes: Damp tollhouse/shrine complex with fortified thresholds, collapsed rooms, and marsh-adjacent branches.

rooms.name: Sunken Toll Hall
rooms.readAloud: Cold water laps across cracked flagstones. Rotted toll plaques hang from bronze hooks, and a stairwell descends into green lantern-light.
rooms.gmNotes: The hooks are noisy if disturbed. A wet trail leads from the north door to Room 3.

inhabitants.name: Bandit Mudwatchers
inhabitants.threat: Low individually, Moderate if they alert others
inhabitants.tactics: Hide behind toll pillars, shout warnings, retreat upstairs
inhabitants.wants: A clean escape and proof their captain abandoned them
inhabitants.leverage: Can be turned with safe passage and a share of recovered coin

rooms.treasure: A locked strongbox with old bridge tokens worth a modest purse.
rooms.secrets: A loose plaque hides a narrow crawlspace to Room 4.
rooms.exits: East to Room 2, hidden crawlspace to Room 4.

rooms.name: Ledger Crypt
rooms.readAloud: Stone shelves hold warped ledgers wrapped like burial shrouds. The room smells of ink, peat, and old coins.
rooms.gmNotes: Reading the saint names aloud quiets the restless spirits for a few minutes.

inhabitants.name: Tollkeeper Spirits
inhabitants.tactics: Block exits, demand payment, punish obvious theft
inhabitants.morale: Fade if properly acknowledged or repaid
inhabitants.leverage: Accept names, rites, or recovered toll tokens as payment

rooms.treasure: Three silver reliquary seals tucked inside a dry ledger case.
rooms.secrets: One ledger lists a hidden reliquary door in Room 8.
rooms.exits: West to Room 1, south to Room 4.

rooms.name: Collapsed Washroom
rooms.readAloud: A half-collapsed chamber gurgles with water draining through broken tile. Pale roots tremble whenever the bell rings.
rooms.gmNotes: The floor gives way under heavy movement, dropping someone into a waist-deep cistern channel.
rooms.treasure: A waterproof scroll tube wedged under tile fragments.
rooms.secrets: The drain grate can be removed to reach Room 6 by crawling.

structuredExits.label: Route to Room 4
structuredExits.description: East to Room 4.

rooms.name: Bonepicker Den
rooms.readAloud: Candle stubs glow in clam shells around a nest of blankets, bones, and stolen road signs.
rooms.gmNotes: The denizens know about the reliquary door but are terrified of the bell chamber.

inhabitants.name: Goblin Bonepickers
inhabitants.morale: Flee if their leader is defeated
inhabitants.leverage: Can be bribed with shiny objects or fresh meat

rooms.treasure: A pouch of mismatched gems hidden inside a cracked road sign.
rooms.secrets: A chalk map marks a bypass around Room 7.
rooms.exits: North arch to Room 2, washroom gap to Room 3, low tunnel to Room 5, hidden crawlspace to Room 1.

rooms.name: Root-Choked Nave
rooms.readAloud: Tree roots pierce the ceiling like black ribs. Broken pews drift in shallow water around a tilted altar stone.
rooms.gmNotes: The altar can be shifted by a group effort, revealing a dry stair to Room 8.

inhabitants.name: Marsh Beasts
inhabitants.tactics: Drag prey into deeper channels and strike from cover
inhabitants.morale: Withdraw if the water is cleared or made painful
inhabitants.wants: Fresh food and an undisturbed nest
inhabitants.leverage: Bright flame and loud bell tones drive them back

rooms.treasure: A saint medallion wrapped around an altar peg.
rooms.secrets: Moving the altar reveals stairs to Room 8.
rooms.exits: West to Room 4, north to Room 6, south stair to Room 8, east to Room 9.

rooms.name: Bell Chain Well
rooms.readAloud: A massive chain drops through a round shaft into darkness. Every link is slick with green-black water.
rooms.gmNotes: Pulling the chain rings the buried bell, opening Room 9 but attracting a wandering encounter.
rooms.treasure: A brass handbell that muffles nearby footfalls for a short time.
rooms.secrets: A carved mark shows the proper rhythm: three short pulls, one long pull.

structuredExits.label: Route to Room 5
structuredExits.description: South to Room 5.

rooms.name: Smuggler Cache
rooms.readAloud: Waxed crates sit above the floodline on a wooden platform. Someone has painted warning marks over every latch.
rooms.gmNotes: Two crates are trapped with snapping wire and a falling chime rack.
rooms.treasure: Trade silver, dry rations, and a wrapped ceremonial dagger.
rooms.secrets: A false crate bottom holds letters naming the bandit captain.

structuredExits.label: Route to Room 8
structuredExits.description: Narrow tunnel to Room 8.

rooms.name: Reliquary of Weeping Stone
rooms.readAloud: Water beads on a statue whose face has been carefully scratched away. Brass niches line the walls, most of them empty.
rooms.gmNotes: Returning a reliquary seal lets the party ask one truthful question about the shrine.

inhabitants.name: Glass-Eyed Cultists
inhabitants.tactics: Feign devotion, separate one target, bargain for relics
inhabitants.morale: Surrender if their false rite is exposed
inhabitants.wants: The bell clapper and a believable escape story
inhabitants.leverage: Their leader fears public shame more than injury

rooms.treasure: A river saint relic, useful as proof to local priests.
rooms.secrets: A pressure niche opens a quiet passage to Room 9.
rooms.exits: Stairs to Room 5, tunnel to Room 7, hidden passage to Room 9.

rooms.name: The Drowned Bell
rooms.readAloud: A bronze bell as wide as a wagon hangs upside down over black water. Something pale moves inside its hollow mouth.
rooms.gmNotes: The final confrontation can be solved by breaking, blessing, or bargaining over the bell clapper.

inhabitants.name: The Bell-Wound Guardian
inhabitants.tactics: Use bell tones to disorient, command spirits, retreat into water
inhabitants.morale: Stops fighting if the clapper is surrendered or sanctified
inhabitants.wants: Silence from the living and custody of the shrine relics
inhabitants.leverage: It remembers its oath and can be appealed to as a protector

rooms.treasure: The bell clapper, a ceremonial relic, and water-bright coins.
rooms.secrets: The bell contains the name of the forgotten saint etched inside the rim.
rooms.exits: West to Room 5, hidden passage to Room 8.

gmNotes: Keep the bell audible throughout play; it should feel like a timer, not just a location.
Most inhabitants can talk if approached carefully. The shrine is tense, not mindless.
Use rising water as pressure when scenes stall.
The final room supports combat, negotiation, or ritual repair.
